rationale: The stock gapped up ~36% with no identifiable news catalyst and is now consolidating in a very narrow band (ATR $0.04 on 5-min bars) in the lower third of today's range, slightly below the 5-min VWAP of $5.32. Volume on the last four candles has collapsed dramatically (from 25K to under 2K-7K), indicating no directional conviction — neither buyers nor sellers are pressing, making a reliable short or long entry mechanically unsound. The wide spread (56.7 bps) on a micro-cap with no borrow/short-interest data and no news context adds execution and risk uncertainty that offsets any edge from the fade-from-high thesis.
